messages:
maria: Heads-up — Acme reported a vectors/sec drop starting ~03:20 UTC after last infra rollout. Tokens/sec looks normal.

ken: Can you paste the customer request + example ids? Any 4xx/5xx spikes?

maria: Two sample request ids: req_85c9, req_85d0. They got 200s but vectors are sometimes length 0 (~1/300).

support-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed at 2026-03-16T03:12:07Z — canary->stable default-batch-window=20ms 🟢

ryan: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal/boards/vecs?panel=queue_depth shows gpu_util jumped and queue_depth spiked right after rollout.

maria: logs snippet from customer-proxy around the time:
```
2026-03-16T03:21:05Z kvcache_enqueue request=req_85c9 queue_depth=3120 batch_size=4 gpu_util=96% kvcache_hits=0
2026-03-16T03:21:05Z encode done request=req_85c9 embedding_len=0
```

ken: embedding_len=0 is odd — could be an early-return fallback or a vector serialization error. Any OOMs or container restarts? @infra-oncall?

infra-oncall: We saw micro-restarts on node gpu-45 at 03:20 due to OOM in tensor-cache. Autoscaler removed 3 nodes during scale-down window, then re-added, which caused backlog/drain problems.

ryan: That pattern makes sense: lowering batch-window -> more tiny batches -> higher memory fragmentation and kv-cache thrash. Combined with scale-down we pushed nodes under memory pressure; some worker paths do an early-return (empty vector) on cache failure to avoid blocking the GPU.

maria: Repro steps I ran in staging (to reproduce customer behaviour):
1) set BATCH_WINDOW_MS=20 (was 50)
2) send 10k inputs of ~512 tokens, hint batch_size=128
3) observe p99 vectors/sec drop and occasional embedding_len=0 responses

curl I used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":["a...512 tokens"]}'
```

ken: Any auth failures or billing 429s from the customer during the window? Could routing to a cheaper model variant cause issues?

maria: They had a handful of 401s earlier due to a rotating key on their side — unrelated. No billing 429s recorded in our logs during the regression window.

infra-oncall: Immediate mitigation applied: revert default-batch-window to 50ms in canary, temporarily disable aggressive scale-down for 15m to let queue drain, and push a config to avoid node removal while memory-pressure > 70%.

ryan: I'll open a runtime PR to: clamp min_embedding_len (treat empty as failure), add a retry path when early-return is triggered, and emit a metric embed_return_len_zero{job="runtime"} so we can alert.

ken: Customer comms: @maria please send an interim status update — say we've mitigated impact and are working on a durable fix + RCA.

maria: Drafting now. Interim note: regression traced to a batch-window change + scale-down timing causing memory starvation micro-restarts; result was intermittent empty embeddings and lower vectors/sec. ETA for full fix: ~24 hours.

support-bot: incident created: INC-2026-89 assigned to @ryan, severity: P2.

ryan: I'll post PR links and verification results back here once tests pass.

maria: Thx — will keep the customer updated and paste their acceptance test results when they re-run.
